title: Visitor and Smile
author: Y. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Vesper Eastwick, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
